title: ButterCraft
description: Adds way to many things related to butter
body:
This mod is for **1.16.5**. Later versions may be added later

_**This mod is a work in progress. Use at own risk**_

![ButterCraft Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6154335f1d8b4afb4c2bafc3790d35f6ae3b9576.png)

This is ButterCraft! **What does it add?:**

- **Butter Ore** You would love to find Butter ore while mining right?
- **Butter Trees** It adds butter trees and butter logs
- **Butter Biome** **BUTTER EVERYWHERE!**
